shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg \"unstable_mockModule|jest\\.mock|Ajv|compile\" src/**/*.test.ts specs -g '*.ts' -g '*.md' | head -120 && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && rg \"specs/.+#\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry compiles a static schema once across ten execute calls$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm run spec:names:fix && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'^ToolRegistry compiles a static schema once across ten execute calls$'"'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test static tool schema compilation caching" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
